items.title: Could IBM (IBM) Reshape Scientific Computing With Its New Quantum Classical Platform?
items.summary: IBM (NYSE:IBM), NVIDIA and Fermilab unveiled a modular quantum classical computing platform that pairs IBM Nighthawk quantum processors with NVIDIA systems. The collaboration places NVIDIA DGX B200 infrastructure in the same facility as IBM's latest quantum hardware to tighten system integration for research workloads.
